findings.message: The source bump (commit 000000000000000000000000000000000a → 000000000000000000000000000000000b) drops the build-marker part from rockcraft.yaml. The upstream commit message and PR author confirm this is intentional: 'Intentionally remove the unused build-marker part.' / 'I confirm that removing build-marker is intentional. It is an empty nil part with no outputs or users; please retain its removal in this source update.' Evidence confirms build-marker is a nil part with no source, packages, scripts or output, and no other part depends on it. The removal changes neither the installed filesystem nor the service execution contract. Not a blocker.

summary: The trigger bumps a single OCI image's source commit within an existing, stable release track (1.2-24.04). The underlying recipe removes an unused nil part (build-marker) per explicit upstream and author intent. No other recipe, release policy, or documentation changes are present.
